items.html: In that this vessel is not in the Yesod alone, but they are the actual mochin throughout the entire stature of Aba and Bina, and throughout the entire stature of ZA and the entire stature of the Nukva; and from the aggregate of those five Hasadim, it is also drawn into their Yesod. And then the females — Ima and Malchut — receive these mochin through their husbands, this one face to face and that one back to back, and their bodies are built. And the aggregate of her Hasadim, ReYu, is given in her in the aspect of back to back, and then she becomes a vessel.
